verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app. In-product AI insights, such as security recommendations about stored accounts, are something a product of this type could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The documented features cover token generation, multi-device sync, encrypted backup, device management and QR capture only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
